description: This file defines a custom subclass of ImageView called RecyclingImageView, which manages drawable display notifications for memory management. It overrides methods to handle setting images and detaching from window, propagating display status to contained drawables.

classes.name: RecyclingImageView
classes.description: Custom ImageView that notifies its drawable when it is displayed or no longer displayed, aiding in bitmap recycling for efficient memory use.

methods.name: RecyclingImageView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with context and attributes.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Overrides to clear the drawable when the view is detached from window.

methods.name: setImageDrawable
methods.description: Overrides to keep track of the drawable being set and notify it of display status changes.
